title: RedteamOutput
description: Structured adversarial analysis output: failure modes, assumptions, adversarial questions, decision recommendation, and extracted commitments — all grounded in transcript evidence.

summary.description: Executive summary of the red-team analysis. 2-4 sentences covering the most critical failure modes, the decision recommendation, and overall risk posture.

overall_risk_level.description: Aggregate risk level reflecting the combined severity and likelihood of identified failure modes.

thesis_under_test.description: The core thesis or proposal being stress-tested. In transcript_only mode, this is inferred from the transcript's central discussion. In transcript_plus_focus mode, this is derived from focus_idea.

key_assumptions.description: Implicit or explicit assumptions underlying the thesis. Each is assessed for confidence and grounded in transcript evidence.

failure_modes.description: Specific ways the thesis, plan, or decision could fail. Each includes severity, likelihood, leading indicators, and mitigation.

adversarial_questions.description: Sharp, specific questions that challenge the thesis. Designed to surface blind spots the team has not addressed.

decision_recommendation.description: Overall recommendation on whether to proceed, pause, or stop, with rationale and required next checks.

commitments_extracted.description: Promises, deadlines, and deliverables extracted from the transcript. Each includes an owner, timeline, and proof artifact.

citations.description: Verbatim quotes from the transcript that ground the analysis. Referenced by failure modes, assumptions, and recommendations.

metadata.description: Analysis metadata: which input mode was used and when the output was generated.

confidence.description: Confidence that this assumption is true, based on transcript evidence. 0.0 = no support, 1.0 = strongly supported.

evidence_from_transcript.description: Verbatim or near-verbatim quote from the transcript supporting or undermining this assumption.

id.description: Unique identifier for this failure mode. Format: FM-001, FM-002, etc.

title.description: Concise, specific title. Avoid generic labels — tie to concrete meeting content.

severity.description: Impact magnitude if this failure occurs. 1 = minor inconvenience, 5 = existential/catastrophic.

likelihood.description: Probability of occurrence given current evidence. 1 = very unlikely, 5 = near certain.

why_it_fails.description: Explanation of the causal mechanism: what specifically goes wrong and why.

leading_indicators.description: Observable signals that this failure mode is materializing. Should be specific enough to monitor.

mitigation.description: Specific, actionable mitigation. Not a restatement of the risk — a concrete step to reduce severity or likelihood.

recommendation.description: proceed = green light. proceed_with_guards = go but with specific safeguards. pause = hold until checks complete. stop = do not proceed.

rationale.description: Why this recommendation, grounded in the failure modes and assumptions identified.

required_next_checks.description: Specific checks or validations that must happen before or alongside proceeding.

owner.description: Person who made the commitment, as identified in the transcript.

due_date_or_window.description: When the commitment is due. Exact date or time window as stated in the transcript.

commitment.description: What was promised or agreed to.

proof_artifact.description: Tangible output that would prove this commitment was fulfilled.

approximate_location.description: Where in the transcript this appears. Examples: 'early in discussion', 'during staffing debate', 'closing remarks'.

mode_used.description: Which input mode was detected. transcript_only if no focus_idea or focus_questions were provided; transcript_plus_focus otherwise.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this analysis was generated.
